sourceAuthority.form: Confirmed existing-world refinement; no seed, QUALITY BAR, generated comp or retrospective per-route approval.

previewPolicy.scope: Ten self-contained ds- HTML/CSS excerpts. Root CSS variables inherit into the shadow DOM; no framework, external image, font, script or stylesheet is required by a snippet.
previewPolicy.interaction: Buttons are type=button, fields have no submission name or form, and links are fragment-only. Error-summary previews omit autofocus so the panel does not steal focus. These are not operational account/API controls or actual account results.
previewPolicy.states: Authored hover, active and focus states are retained where the source has them. Fields have no invented hover treatment; the success paragraph is noninteractive. Browser disclosure, validation and autofill surfaces remain native.
previewPolicy.rasterPatterns: The panorama and raster-led update rows remain documented source patterns, not recreated with substitute art or glyphs in the previews.
previewPolicy.tonalRamps: Swatch-display metadata only, never normative CSS tokens or approved contrast pairs. Surface strips use the eight existing dark-to-light ground roles (light page and surface intentionally coincide). Other strips use synthetic relative-OKLCH lightness stops while retaining each recorded color's chroma/hue. Do not inherit these strips as a new palette scale.

dark-inset.displayName: Dark inset identity and disabled ground

display.purpose: Georgia h1; homepage narrow override belongs to its layout, not a modular scale.

account-display.purpose: Registration, result and notice h1 within the focused account frame.

headline.purpose: Regular-weight serif h2; status has its own smaller local override.

title.purpose: Sans h3 for steps/updates and the error-summary h2 with normal letter spacing.

body.purpose: Readable copy and input text, normally bounded at 72ch for paragraphs.

label.purpose: Visible medium-weight field names; not an eyebrow or display role.

note.purpose: Notes, helpers, navigation and dates; note color is muted.

button.purpose: Medium-weight control text with shorter line height and wrapping.

brand.purpose: Bold local sans label beside the unchanged cube and subordinate MS2 tag.

data.purpose: Relative-size local code stack with tabular numerals, not decorative technical styling.

depth.method: No authored box/text shadows, gradients, glass blur or hover lift. Use the existing tonal surfaces, spacing and thin boundaries; artwork retains its natural depth.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared button background, border and text-color transitions.

motion.name: ease-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared short control feedback, without transforms or entrance animation.

mediaOverrides.(forced-colors: active): Button and brand-label borders use ButtonText; inputs/error/success borders use CanvasText; focus outlines use Highlight.

breakpoints.purpose: Literal max-width query: static wrapping navigation, stacked portal columns, reordered update rows and mobile panorama source.

control-target.purpose: Minimum block size for discrete controls, never a fixed height or a rule for inline-prose links.

layout.recoveryFrame: 44rem maximum within the shared container; wrapping actions
layout.focus: 3px solid var(--accent), offset 4px; programmatic/native focus also outlined on account summaries/notices
layout.print: The portal hides header/art/footer/skip link, simplifies columns, avoids splitting grouped content and exposes details content. Source behavior, not cross-browser print certification.

extensions.nativeSurfaces: Selection uses the accent pair; the caret uses accent; scrollbars use input-border/page. Native summary markers, required-field validation, password/autofill UI and control semantics are not bespoke dialogs, tooltips or menus.

artwork.attribution: MapleStory 2 artwork copyright NEXON. Independent, non-commercial, non-affiliated project; retain the website attribution.
artwork.metadataPolicy: Provenance belongs in documentation/this sidecar. Do not modify image metadata or any preserved artwork bytes.

narrative.overview:
This names the confirmed existing-world refinement, not a new metaphor selection or generated concept. Maple-orange controls, near-neutral ground, editorial serif headings and compact rounded forms provide the MS1-family resemblance. The original cube and authentic MS2 scenery, logo and creatures establish the second game's identity; the interface does not repaint them to match its accent.

Space, reading measure and visible state do the organizing. Dashed rules separate content; tonal containers support disclosures, feedback and bounded information. Density follows the task rather than a universal landing-page composition. Native controls remain useful without JavaScript, and both system color schemes receive explicit colors instead of automatic inversion.
keyCharacteristics: Maple-orange interaction on explicit light and dark neutral grounds.
Georgia display, local interface and code stacks; no downloaded fonts.
Authentic MS2 identity kept separate from reusable interface color tokens.
Flat, rounded controls with native behavior and visible recovery states.

rules.name: The Semantic Orange Rule
rules.body: Use the current theme's accent pair for interaction; state colors describe outcomes, and the native cube/artwork retain their own colors.

rules.name: The Editorial Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep Georgia for the large heading hierarchy and the local sans stack for controls, labels and compact task headings.

rules.name: The Tone Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate authored interface surfaces with tone, spacing and rules, not shadows; retain natural depth inside the MS2 artwork.

dos: **Do** derive shared colors and base controls from `website/theme.css`, including its embedded account use.
**Do** use the current theme's paired foregrounds, text labels and visible focus to communicate state.
**Do** preserve native disclosure/form behavior, wrapping controls and reduced-motion feedback.
**Do** keep approved MS2 artwork bytes, attribution and provenance separate from UI tokens.
**Do** read the matching surface brief before applying a route's composition or recovery strategy.
donts: **Don't** duplicate the shared theme or claim Newsreader, downloaded fonts or remote account assets are loaded.
**Don't** add authored shadows, glass or hover lifts to this flat interface, or flatten the depth in native artwork.
**Don't** treat the homepage panorama, ordered setup composition or factual status container as mandatory on account and recovery surfaces.
**Don't** replace SVG interface icons with text glyphs, or turn the MS2 identity tag into an invented chip/filter system.
**Don't** present preview excerpts, synthetic tonal strips, fixture results or the bounded ship verdict as live-account, deployment or accessibility certification.
